title: PocketFurnace
description: Portable furnace plugin for PaperMC and that forks.
body:
# PocketFurnace

PocketFurnace is a powerful and lightweight plugin for PaperMC and its forks that brings portable, parallel smelting to your server.  
No more waiting for a single furnace — carry your smelting power in your pocket!

## 🌟 Features

- Portable Smelting: Open your furnace anywhere, anytime via a handheld item.

- Parallel Processing: Smelt multiple items simultaneously to save time.

- Batch Input Support: Quickly load fuel and items using Shift + Left Click.

- Scalable Sizes: Choose between 4, 8, or 12 slot configurations based on your needs.

- Intuitive UI: Simple interaction with a dedicated "Result" button (Chest icon) to collect your items.

## 📖 How to Use

1. Create: Generate a pocket furnace using the command:
    /pocketfurnace furnace create <size>

2. Open: Interact with the pocket furnace item in your hand.

3. Load: Put your fuel and ore/items into the UI.
    Tip: Use Shift + Left Click for batch input!

4. Process: Click the Result button (Chest icon) to finish the smelting process.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7bec4563-144c-44ba-93f8-4f53ac37c99b

## ⚒ Install

- Download `.jar` file from Modrinth or GitHub releases.
- Place the downloaded file in your server's `/plugins` directory.

## 💻 Commands
### `/pocketfurnace furnace create <size>`

Creates a specified size PocketFurnace.  
`<size>` must be 4, 8 or 12.  

### `/pocketfurnace furnace clone`

This command clones a pocket furnace into your main hand.

### `/pockerfurnace help`

Shows command help.  
`/pocketfurnace help japanese` を実行すると日本語版のコマンドヘルプが表示されます。  

## 🔐 Permissions
### `furnace.create.<size>`

Limit the maximum size of pocket furnaces.  

Default (Not OP): `furnace.create.4`  
Default (OP): `furnace.create.12`
